answer_1.quote: We employ three types of long-range evaluation: language modeling, long-range understanding, and text generation... We prompt the models to generate a long story... We report the geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L scores (based on the gold summary)...
answer_1.outputs: generated text, summaries, QA answers, story continuations

answer_2.quote: We report perplexity on the PG-19 test set... For SQuALITY, we report the geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L scores... For QASPER, we report F1 score.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT‑4 as an evaluator. For each seed, we compare the two generated stories by asking GPT‑4 which is better, reporting the average win rate for each approach.
